species.name: Panda
mustRead: black teardrop eye patches on a white face
black shoulder band joining black forelegs
round bulky body with a very round head
species.note: the tail is short but white and visible; the ears are black and round

species.name: Red Panda
mustRead: long bushy tail with pale rings
white face mask with rust tear-stripes below the eyes
rusty-red coat with jet-black legs and belly
species.note: raccoon-sized, not bear-sized, and unrelated to the giant panda

species.name: Asian Elephant
mustRead: twin-domed forehead with a dip between
convex arched back and a single-lipped trunk tip
species.note: the back is humped/convex where an African elephant's dips, and the ears are far smaller

species.name: Takin
mustRead: horns sweeping outward then back like a wildebeest's
humped shoulders on short thick legs
long shaggy golden coat with an arched Roman-nosed muzzle
species.note: a goat-antelope built like a small bison - far stockier than any goat

species.name: Gecko
mustRead: huge lidless eyes with vertical pupils
broad splayed toes with lamellae pads
soft granular bumpy skin and a plump tail
species.note: most geckos cannot blink - the eyes are covered by a fixed clear scale and licked clean

species.name: Skink
mustRead: cylindrical body with very small short legs
tapering tail as long as the body
species.note: generic representative: a typical ground skink; it looks polished and almost limbless, not spiky or crested

species.name: Black Bear
mustRead: straight facial profile with a tan muzzle
tall rounded ears and short curved claws
species.note: no shoulder hump - the highest point is the hindquarters, the opposite of a brown bear

species.name: Brown Bear
mustRead: dished concave face with a broad forehead
species.note: the shoulder hump is the diagnostic - it makes the front of the animal the tallest point

species.name: Wolf
mustRead: broad blocky head with erect triangular ears
long legs and a narrow deep chest
straight bushy tail carried level or low
species.note: the tail hangs straight and never curls over the back the way a husky's does

species.name: Coyote
species.note: Slighter and leggier than a wolf; tail hangs down rather than out.

species.name: Bobcat
species.note: Tail is a stub of 3-4 head-widths' worth of body length, not a full cat tail.

species.name: Lynx
mustRead: oversized snowshoe paws and long hind legs

species.name: Fox
mustRead: low slender body on black stockings
species.note: Read as red fox. Body is far lower and lighter than a dog's; the tail is nearly body-length.

species.name: Raccoon
mustRead: black bandit mask across the eyes
hunched arched back with rump higher than shoulders

species.name: Badger
mustRead: white stripe running back over the face

species.name: Weasel
species.note: Body is serpentine, often drawn arched; the head is barely wider than the neck.

species.name: Marten
mustRead: large rounded ears on a foxy face

species.name: Flying Squirrel
mustRead: loose skin flap stretched from wrist to ankle

species.name: Chipmunk
mustRead: bold dark and pale stripes along back and face

species.name: Mouse
mustRead: naked tail as long as the body

species.name: Vole
species.note: Often drawn as a mouse; a vole is fatter, blunter-faced, short-tailed and small-eared.
